reasoning_trace.description: MANDATORY: You MUST describe what you see in the images (Charts, System Models) to prove you have analyzed them. If images are provided, list specific visual details.
reasoning_trace.value: The paper includes several figures, including Fig. 1, which depicts a UAV-based IPSAC scenario, and Fig. 2, which illustrates the transmitter of the CEO-OFDM system. Other figures, such as Fig. 3, show the signal flowchart of the proposed passive sensing algorithm, and Fig. 4, which presents the analysis of BER and TDOA error performance under different β/Pmax values.

reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system mechanism is based on CEO-OFDM, which uses a cyclic prefix (CP) to mitigate clipping distortion caused by peak power limitations. The ISAC coupling mode is achieved through the use of the CP for correlation analysis in estimating the TDOA of the signal, allowing for precise distance and velocity measurements.

reasoning_trace.description: Validate the physical consistency of reported metrics (Rate/Resolution).
reasoning_trace.value: The paper reports that the proposed CEO-OFDM system outperforms DCO-OFDM and ACO-OFDM systems in terms of BER performance and TDOA error. The results show that the TDOA estimation error in the CEO-OFDM system is 4 times less than that of the DCO-OFDM system and 2 times less than that of the ACO-OFDM system.

reasoning_trace.description: Identify the solved problems and remaining open challenges.
reasoning_trace.value: The paper solves the problem of efficient target detection and TDOA estimation in OWC systems with peak power constraints. However, the system's performance in multi-path environments and the impact of noise on the sensing accuracy are not fully addressed and remain as open challenges.

bibliographic.title: Passive Sensing Technique Using Cyclic Prefix in Power-Constrained Optical Wireless Communication Systems
bibliographic.authors: Benben Li, Jiale Wang, Dianbin Lian, Yan Gao, Jie Lian, Chengkai Tang, and Baowang Lian

key_contribution.key_contribution: The paper proposes a novel approach using the cyclic prefix (CP) of the signal frame in a clipping-enhanced optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (CEO-OFDM) system for integrated passive sensing and communication (IPSAC).
key_contribution.gap_addressed: The paper addresses the challenge of efficient target detection and TDOA estimation in OWC systems with peak power constraints.

quality_assessment.tqaf_notes: The paper provides a clear description of the system model and the simulation parameters. However, the experimental setup and the measurement procedures are not fully described.
